Quiz attempt

/courses/:courseId/quizzes/:quizId/attempts/:attemptId
Roles: studentScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S10

Answer a fixed quiz version with clear save status, timing and an explicit review/submit step. Preserve acknowledged answers through interruptions without promising impossible web lockdown or background sync.

Return to answersSubmit attempt
Permissions
  • Only learner's active attempt is editable; authorization rechecked on resume.
  • Attempt prompts/order/rules remain snapshotted despite later authoring.
  • No client focus counter deletes answers, changes grade or automatically cancels.
Responsive
  • Question navigation becomes a labelled collapsible list on narrow web.
  • Timer/save strip cannot obscure prompt or keyboard-focused answer.
Accessibility
  • Timer uses role=timer without announcing every second; meaningful warnings are polite.
  • Question inputs use fieldsets, labels, units and accessible math/media; all review navigation works by keyboard.
Data
  • Immutable quiz-attempt question/rule snapshot and personal deadline.
  • Per-answer draft/acknowledged versions, review flags and submission operation state.
Acceptance checks (4)
  • Quiz edits after Start never alter this attempt's prompts or answers.
  • A connectivity loss preserves acknowledged answers and labels unsent edits honestly.
  • Repeated submit/status checks resolve one receipt; focus loss never auto-cancels.
  • At effective deadline, lock edits and resolve finalization of acknowledged answers once; offline unacknowledged edits remain labeled unsent and require recovery, not an invented accepted timestamp.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
  • Proposed quiz deadline = earlier of personal close and startedAt + effective duration; untimed quiz ends at personal close. Show a shortened window before Start. Use one timer allowance mode (extra minutes OR multiplier), not both. At expiry finalize only acknowledged answers; unsent offline text remains a recoverable local draft requiring staff review, never a fake accepted receipt.
